attachments.title: <https://github.com/vim/vim/pull/8856|#8856 Add ModeChanged autocmd>
attachments.text:
• Triggers *after* every mode change (PreModeChanged could be added later if someone needs it)
• The pattern can match `old_mode:new_mode`, for example `au ModeChanged v:V` is only triggered on Visual -> Visual Line mode change and `au ModeChanged *:n` is triggered if any other mode switches back to normal mode.
• Also adds an unit test for correctly counting mode changes

text:
```
                                                        *getcharpos()*
getcharpos({expr})
                Get the position for String {expr}. Same as |getpos()| but the
                column number in the returned List is a character index
                instead of a byte index.
                If |getpos()| returns a very large column number, such as
                2147483647, then getcharpos() will return the character index
                of the last character.
 
                Example:
                With the cursor on '세' in line 5 with text "여보세요":  
                        getcharpos('.')         returns [0, 5, 3, 0]
                        getpos('.')             returns [0, 5, 7, 0]
 
                Can also be used as a |method|:  
                        GetMark()->getcharpos()
```
